title: maint.event.v1{kind=spool_entry_aged_out}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.3 — emitted when a spool entry in opsctl_spool or agent_spool is pruned because its age exceeds cfg.maint_spool_entry_max_age_h. Notification only.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

target.description: Agent name owning the spool (e.g. 'maint.scaler.v1') or 'opsctl' for the opsctl spool.

request_id.description: The request_id from the aged-out spool entry.

age_h.description: How old the spool entry was in hours at prune time.

entry_kind.description: The maint.event.v1 kind field from the aged-out envelope payload.
